title: Synthetic version migration readiness
method: Fifteen fictional registered integrations: nine pass the replacement contract suite, four are migrating, and two lack a confirmed owner. Readiness is 9/15 = 60%; quiet traffic is not treated as migration evidence.
alt: Synthetic version migration readiness. Verified migration: 9 integrations; Migration in progress: 4 integrations; Owner unresolved: 2 integrations. Illustrative inputs.
